title: PR #112 closeout — reconcile macOS quit evidence before UX Phase 2
description:
Milestone scope: close out five unresolved review threads on merged PR #112 before starting UX Phase 2. This issue covers evidence and documentation only; it must not imply that physical tray acceptance passed.

## Success Criteria
- Address all five threads using merged source and same-head evidence: PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pJmZK, PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pLAJi, PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pSwNa, PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pS49n, and PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pS_Ru.
- Root and scoped codemaps, publish checklist, test plan, BOM, and parity matrix identify the current macOS `quit_explicitly` / `std::process::exit(0)` candidate and distinguish automated checks from physical acceptance.
- Record the latest manual Show attempt as timed out without a witnessed callback. Physical Show/Quit, foreground restoration, warm URL delivery, and saved-state restart stay open until directly observed.
- Link the exact PR-head CI, Security, and Dependency Review results; label stale run IDs historical.
- Resolve each review thread only after its specific claim is supported by the accepted follow-up.

## Test Plan
- Run `scripts/test-roadmap-doc-contracts.sh`, `cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`, focused publish/security documentation contract tests, `git diff --check`, and affected advisory, DuckDB, and dependency-floor contracts.
- Require same-head hosted CI, Security (including RustSec/CodeQL/secret scan), and Dependency Review success for the focused follow-up PR.
- Compare changed statements with merged source at `main`; verify all five GitHub review threads are resolved after the fix.
- Keep human-observed tray acceptance as a separate release gate. CI success and a timeout are not substitutes.

## Delivery
Create one focused documentation/remediation commit and PR from verified latest `main`. Resolve the five review threads after matching evidence is accepted; only then unblock `BI-5u3.3`. Do not commit unrelated dirty worktree changes.
acceptance_criteria: All five listed review threads are addressed by a focused, same-head-validated follow-up with source-aligned docs and exact CI/security/dependency evidence; physical macOS acceptance remains explicitly pending until a successful witnessed run.

title: Prioritize critical manager stages before action truncation
description:
PR #114 review follow-up: manager recommendations and the manager action route currently select the first two critical/high stages in payload order. A critical bottleneck later in the import can be hidden behind earlier high stages.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Import at least three actionable stages.
2. Put two high-impact/high-severity stages before a critical stage in payload order.
3. Inspect the manager recommendation and manager action route.
4. Confirm the critical stage is selected before truncation to two actions.

## Test Plan
Add a regression with two high stages preceding a later critical stage and assert the critical stage appears first in both manager outputs. Verify impact ordering and deterministic ties. Run TypeScript, focused and full Vitest, production build, then hosted same-head CI and review-thread validation.
acceptance_criteria: Critical stages rank ahead of high stages before manager recommendation or route truncation. Higher impact wins within equal severity; ties resolve deterministically. The manager recommendation and manager route both include the later critical stage when earlier high stages appear first in input. Sample fallback and lead, executive, and security outputs remain unchanged. Unit regressions cover both outputs, priority, impact, and deterministic ties.

title: Preserve security signals outside imported result display limits
description:
Follow-up to PR #114 security review comment PRRT_kwDOSr9EN86pURV3. The imported result display can truncate commit-risk records before security classification. Classification must use every validated record, while rendered cards remain bounded.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Create a valid imported payload with more commit-risk records than limits.risks.
2. Place a security-relevant record after that limit and a non-security record beyond it.
3. Import and inspect the full security count, recommendation, action route, displayed risk-card count, and Security panel details.
4. Include more than three security records and confirm the panel reports the number it omits.

## Test Plan
Unit-test hidden security and non-security records. Component-test full-set counts, recommendations, and routes with limits.risks set to 1; verify displayed risk cards stay capped, the Security panel renders no more than three details, and its overflow count is accurate. Run TypeScript, full Vitest, production build, Playwright discovery, and hosted same-head CI/security/dependency review.
design: Use a two-pass or separately derived full-set selector: classify the full validated records first, then apply UI display limits only to presentation. Avoid increasing rendered card counts or changing public payload shapes.
acceptance_criteria: Security-signal presence, counts, recommendations, and routes derive from the complete validated imported dataset, independent of limits.risks. A security record beyond the risk-card limit is counted, recommended, and routed; a hidden non-security record does not increase security counts. The ordinary risk cards remain capped. The Security panel renders at most three details and reports the omitted matching-signal count. Empty, sample, imported, malformed-input, payload, and native-shell contracts remain unchanged. Unit/component tests cover these cases.

title: Do not mark absent risk and stage trends as healthy
description:
Finding: PR #114 review comment “Distinguish absent telemetry from healthy trends.”

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Import an empty payload or a partial payload without commit or stage observations.
2. Inspect the PR Risk Trajectory and Bottleneck Pressure trend lines.
3. Confirm missing observations are not represented as green zero/healthy results.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Without commit-risk records, the PR Risk Trajectory value is Unavailable with neutral status and explicit no-record copy.
- [ ] Without bottleneck records, Bottleneck Pressure is Unavailable with neutral status and explicit no-record copy.
- [ ] When records exist and none are risky/pressured, the cards continue to show observed zero/healthy results.
- [ ] Sample-mode results remain unchanged.

## Test Plan
- Unit-test dashboard visuals for empty, partial, healthy populated, and high-risk/pressured data.
- Component-test empty and partial import trend values and visual status.
- Add a Playwright assertion for empty-import risk and bottleneck trends.
- Run TypeScript, Vitest, production build, Playwright discovery, and hosted same-head UI/aggregate checks.
acceptance_criteria: - No commit-risk records produce an Unavailable neutral PR Risk Trajectory, not a green zero/healthy result. - No bottleneck records produce an Unavailable neutral Bottleneck Pressure, not a green zero/healthy result. - Populated healthy records still show observed healthy zero counts. - Sample mode remains unchanged; unit/component/browser tests cover these states.

title: Add a hosted Playwright gate for frontend UX acceptance
description:
Validation enabler discovered while integrating panel acceptance criteria. The repository has `pnpm run test:e2e` and `ui/e2e/app.spec.ts`, but the current `ui-quality` CI job runs only typecheck, Vitest, and production build.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A UI-triggered hosted job installs the pinned pnpm 12.9.1 dependencies and Playwright browser, then runs `pnpm run test:e2e`.
- [ ] The job produces a distinct check result; failure artifacts include Playwright report/trace or actionable logs.
- [ ] CI timeout and browser installation costs are measured and documented.
- [ ] Branch protection owners confirm whether this check is required before any PR claims hosted browser acceptance; do not claim it is required until verified.

## Test Plan
- Verify workflow parsing and path-trigger behavior for a UI change.
- Run the job on a UI-only PR and confirm both success and a deliberate failing Playwright fixture produce the expected check/artifacts.
- Keep existing typecheck, unit, and build steps intact.

## Scope
This is a CI validation enabler, not a finding from the UX panel. Do not change app product behavior in this issue.
acceptance_criteria: A hosted, UI-triggered Playwright job runs the existing browser suite with pinned tooling and actionable failure artifacts; required-check status is documented from branch-protection evidence.

title: Expose admin, baseline, import, and reset outcomes as accessible statuses
description:
Finding: UX-10, async and success/failure states are not consistently announced.
## Acceptance Criteria
- Admin and baseline operations announce pending and final results through one polite role=status region without moving focus.
- Matching repeat-action buttons are disabled while pending.
- Failure messages remain visible and announced as final status; payload failures remain role=alert and aria-describedby-linked.
- Import/reset state updates use status semantics without duplicate/stale announcements.
## Test Plan
Testing Library uses delayed success and rejected bridge stubs for pending/busy/final success/error. Verify textarea aria-invalid/describedby, error alert, import/reset status. Playwright covers browser shim success/failure. Record manual keyboard/screen-reader spot check, then run full UI and exact-head hosted checks.
## Scope
React/Vite browser preview only; native-shell announcement behavior remains out of scope.
acceptance_criteria:
- Admin/baseline pending and results use one polite live status with aria-busy during pending work.
- Duplicate submissions are disabled while the matching request is pending.
- Payload errors are announced, linked to input, and retain last-good data.
- Tests cover success, failure, pending, import, reset, and no-baseline; manual screen-reader result recorded.

title: Name the Field/Lab switch input accessibly
description:

## Acceptance Criteria

acceptance_criteria:

- Disabled/unchecked state accurately communicates no source is connected.
- Testing Library and Playwright query by role/name and keyboard activation cannot imply data switching.

title: Meet WCAG text contrast for primary buttons and states
description:
Finding: UX-08, the default primary color did not meet normal-text contrast (prior #5577cc/white measured 4.2884:1). Criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3.
## Acceptance Criteria
- Enabled normal-size contained and outlined button text meets 4.5:1 against rendered backgrounds.
- Tests read actual computed foreground/background colors, not only a hard-coded estimate.
- Hover and keyboard-focus states are measured; disabled state is reported separately.
- Color token and measurements are reproducible.
## Test Plan
Testing Library computes ratio from rendered styles. Playwright repeats after hover/focus for contained and outlined actions. Run UI typecheck, Vitest, build, and Playwright; record manual checks separately.
## Scope
React/Vite theme only; this does not claim a full site-wide WCAG audit.
acceptance_criteria:
- Computed normal-size text contrast is at least 4.5:1 for enabled contained and outlined primary actions.
- Automated checks read rendered colors and browser checks include hover and keyboard focus.
- Disabled control states are tested separately from enabled-text contrast.
- Exact pnpm UI and same-head hosted checks pass.

title: Make audit, SEO, and Field/Lab controls honest about available behavior
description:
Finding: UX-03, preview controls imply behavior not implemented.
## Reproduction
Inspect Run Full Audit, SEO scope, and Field/Lab. Activate each and compare displayed data/operation outcome; verify whether separate data sources or an audit engine exist.
## Acceptance Criteria
- No enabled control silently does nothing or changes labels without changing represented results.
- Run Full Audit is disabled and visible copy says audit execution is unavailable.
- The SEO page/site selector is removed until distinct scope data exists; nearby copy identifies static examples and unavailable scope selection.
- Field/Lab selector is visibly labeled and disabled while no source data exists.
- No new browser/native operation or public payload contract is implied.
## Test Plan
Testing Library and Playwright assert disabled audit and Field/Lab controls, explanatory copy, no SEO tab selector, and no false success result. Run UI typecheck, Vitest, production build, and Playwright.
## Scope
React/Vite browser preview only; close after exact-head checks and copy review pass.
acceptance_criteria:
- Audit and Field/Lab controls are visibly unavailable and disabled.
- SEO scope selector is absent until page/site-specific data exists; static-example/unavailable-scope copy is visible.
- Tests confirm no inert action or misleading completed state remains.
- Native shell and command/payload contracts are unchanged.

title: Make score explanation match the score formula
description:

title: PR 3 — Make preview controls and dashboard interactions accessible
description:
Milestone scope: Phase 3 dashboard control and accessibility remediation.
## Success Criteria
UX-03 and UX-08 through UX-11 are resolved: every remaining enabled control has real behavior; unavailable audit and Field/Lab sources are labeled and disabled; the nonfunctional SEO scope selector is removed until real scope data exists; normal-size button text meets WCAG contrast; the switch input has a visible accessible name; async outcomes have live status semantics; one main landmark and nested headings support navigation. Duplicate stage names retain per-row severity.
## Test Plan
Testing Library verifies disabled controls and explanations, role/name/state, status and alert semantics, textarea error associations, main landmark and heading levels, duplicate-row severity, and computed button contrast. Playwright verifies keyboard focus, disabled/unavailable behavior, semantic structure, and computed hover/focus contrast. Run frozen pnpm install, TypeScript, full Vitest, production build, Playwright, and required same-head CI/Security/Dependency Review. Perform manual keyboard-only and screen-reader spot checks before close.
## Delivery
Keep scope to React/Vite preview. Use focused Conventional Commit slices from verified main, enable auto-merge only after same-head required checks and review pass, and close only after human checks are recorded. Preserve native shell and command payload contracts.
acceptance_criteria:
- Unavailable operations are disabled and explained; no inert control implies a completed action.

title: Validate responsive layout and priority task flow before changing layout
description:

Source: Review report UX-13; ui/src/App.tsx:248-267,365-390,454-547,551-686.

## Goal

## Findings
[UNVERIFIED] The panel found source layout facts but had no viewport, screenshot, or task evidence. No layout defect is confirmed. Keep this as a validation-only issue until a concrete impairment is reproduced.

## Acceptance Criteria
[ ] Evidence covers 320, 360, 768, 1024, and 1280 CSS-pixel widths plus 200% zoom.
[ ] Core controls remain visible and reachable, with no horizontal page overflow or clipped text/control; keyboard focus remains visible.
[ ] Task completion and section order are recorded, not inferred from source layout.
[ ] If no task-blocking issue is reproduced, close as validated without code changes; otherwise document the reproducer and propose the smallest responsive/order fix.

## Test Plan

title: Keep severity attached to duplicate stage rows
description:
Follow-up identified while auditing merged PR #118: Job Observability used a name-keyed status map, so duplicate stage names could cause one row to inherit another row's last severity.
## Steps to Reproduce
1. Import two stages with the same name.
2. Give the first healthy queue/latency and the second critical queue/latency.
3. Inspect each Job Observability row.
## Acceptance Criteria
- Each displayed row uses classification derived from its own validated stage record.
- Duplicate names with differing severities do not overwrite or leak severity.
- Do not reject duplicates unless the public payload contract requires uniqueness.
- Existing payload and manager-route behavior remain unchanged.
## Test Plan
Add component regression with duplicate names and healthy/critical values; assert each row's status. Run TypeScript, full Vitest, build, Playwright, and same-head CI/Security/Dependency Review.
## Scope
React/Vite dashboard only; include in Phase 3 follow-up and close only after exact-head checks pass.
acceptance_criteria:
- Duplicate stage names with different metrics retain their own Job Observability statuses.
- Regression asserts healthy duplicate stays good and critical duplicate stays bad.
- Existing telemetry shape and manager severity remain unchanged.
- Full UI and hosted checks pass on exact PR head.
